title: ChargerState
description: Charger operational state published on the device state topic.

state.description: idle = available; reserved = slot held for an incoming robot; charging = actively charging; error = fault

assignedRobotId.description: ID of the robot currently assigned to this charger. Omit when idle.

batteryLevel.description: Robot battery level as a fraction (0.0 – 1.0). Omit when idle.
